Wan2.2 TI2V 5B on Mac: files, RAM and published times

Wan2.2 TI2V 5B is a dense 5B model for text-to-video and image-to-video at 720P and 24 fps. On a Mac it runs through mlx-video, and FastVideo publishes a distilled INT8 derivative.

Wan-AI · Updated 2026-10-24
Answer

Wan2.2 TI2V 5B runs on a Mac with 24 GB or more. A published run on M5 · 24 GB used the FastMetal 5B QAD (DMD2-distilled INT8 derivative, not the base model) build (source, 2026-08-10).

Does it fit your NVIDIA GPU's VRAM?

Runs · Stated means the linked model card, app maker or NVIDIA says a GPU with that much VRAM runs the model; Runs · Published names the card of a dated run. Fits with offload means the main model weights fit in VRAM with a 15% margin but the full set does not: the text encoder and VAE run from system RAM, which is slower. Exceeds VRAM means even the main weights are too large for the card. Mac runs never count here.

Which Mac software routes are listed?

  • ComfyUI

    Official

    Formats: safetensors, gguf. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    On Apple Silicon ComfyUI runs on PyTorch MPS, not MLX. GGUF files need the separate city96/ComfyUI-GGUF custom node. Resident size is the sum of the weights, an upper bound: ComfyUI can unload models between stages and publishes no per-model Mac peak.

    Sources: ComfyUI README · ComfyUI system requirements · ComfyUI CLI arguments · ComfyUI-GGUF README

  • FastVideo MLX (FastMetal)

    Community

    Formats: mlx. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    FastMetal checkpoints are distilled INT8 derivatives; their times are not base-model figures.

    Sources: FastVideo MLX install guide

  • Blaizzy/mlx-video

    Community

    Formats: mlx, safetensors. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    Sources: mlx-video Wan README

What does the official configuration say?

"The official native runner needs a GPU with at least 24GB VRAM. No official Mac memory minimum was found."

Source: Wan2.2 TI2V 5B model card · Read 2026-10-24.

What known issues should you check?

  • Known issue 1

    FastMetal 5B QAD is a three-step distilled INT8 derivative, so its times and memory are not base-model figures.

    Source: FastMetal-QAD announcement · Read 2026-10-24

  • Known issue 2

    mlx-video lists 40 steps for TI2V-5B while the official Wan config uses 50, so pass the step count explicitly when comparing times.

    Source: Wan2.2 TI2V 5B config · Read 2026-10-24

Frequently asked questions

How fast is Wan2.2 5B on a Mac?

The full model through mlx-video took 17:43 for a 41-frame 1280x704 clip at 40 steps on an M3 Max with 64 GB, peaking at 56.4 GB. The distilled FastMetal 5B derivative took 151.42 s for an 81-frame clip on an M4 Max with 36 GB, so the two are not comparable.

What is the FastMetal 5B build?

FastMetal 5B QAD is a DMD2-distilled, 3-step, INT8 derivative of Wan2.2 TI2V 5B published by FastVideo. It is not the base 50-step model, so its times and memory describe the derivative only.
